incremental_update.benchmark_limitations: Structured fresh-fact extraction is conservative under the deterministic reference extractor (discovering ~10% on explicit attribute statements). Stale-fact precision is marked NOT_MEASURED due to the absence of false-invalidation negative denominators across untouched paragraphs.

A_bm25_only.name: BM25 Lexical Retrieval Only
A_bm25_only.description: Lexical BM25 retrieval without dense semantic vectors

B_dense_only.name: Dense Vector Search Only
B_dense_only.description: Dense vector search without BM25 keyword matching

C_hybrid_retrieval.name: Hybrid RRF Retrieval
C_hybrid_retrieval.description: Reciprocal Rank Fusion of BM25 and dense embeddings

D_hybrid_plus_alias_expansion.name: Hybrid + Alias Expansion
D_hybrid_plus_alias_expansion.description: Hybrid retrieval with alias and nickname graph expansion

E_hybrid_plus_structured_story_memory.name: Hybrid + Story Memory Filter
E_hybrid_plus_structured_story_memory.description: Hybrid retrieval combined with structured memory entity filters

F_without_temporal_scoping.name: Without Temporal Scoping
F_without_temporal_scoping.description: System without timeline event and temporal scope filters
F_without_temporal_scoping.notes: No temporal order contradictions are masked by time filtering in current 16 held-out story packs.

G_without_narrative_epistemic_scoping.name: Without Epistemic Scoping
G_without_narrative_epistemic_scoping.description: System treating dreams, rumors, and POV beliefs as global canon

H_without_evidence_critic.name: Without Evidence Critic
H_without_evidence_critic.description: System without pre-alert evidence validation gate
H_without_evidence_critic.notes: Current gold evaluation fixtures contain well-formed citation anchors that pass critic validation.

I_without_author_intentionality_rules.name: Without Author Preconditions
I_without_author_intentionality_rules.description: System without author suppression and exception persistence
I_without_author_intentionality_rules.notes: Not measured on main corpus because no author decision overrides are persisted in the cold held-out story packs.

J_long_context_baseline.name: Raw Context Baseline
J_long_context_baseline.description: Direct un-indexed context baseline over raw recent manuscript chunks (first 5 blocks only)

K_full_system.name: Full Reference System
K_full_system.description: Full hybrid retrieval, structured memory, epistemic reasoning, critic, and validator

limitations: Synthetic evaluation is not a substitute for qualitative author/editor studies.
Literary ambiguity can never be fully reduced to binary structured facts.
Entity resolution becomes challenging with homonyms and deliberately deceptive naming.
Nonlinear narrative timeframes require explicit chapter sequencing cues.
Cloud provider live validation requires authorized cloud credentials.
